install: portable ZIP extracted to tools/blender-4.5.13-windows-x64/ (gitignored); no system install, no administrator rights, reversible by deleting the folder
licence: GNU GPL v2 or later (the application; renders produced with it are unencumbered)
render_device: CUDA, NVIDIA GeForce MX130 (2 GB VRAM)
engine_decision: Cycles. EEVEE renders headless on this machine only through a software-GL fallback: 105.8 s for a 64x64 probe frame versus 2.1 s for Cycles on the GPU.
known_constraint: 2 GB VRAM is exhausted partway through a multi-frame session; mitigated by CPU denoising and 512 px auto-tiles, with an automatic CPU retry per frame.
